text:
Mei Chen: heads-up — while bringing up orca-lite-v2 (q4) on staging I hit a small but consistent quality regression on our ja-zh translation eval. BLEU dropped ~3.2 vs baseline. looks like token alignment shifted for mixed-fullwidth/halfwidth punctuation lines.

Arjun Patel: do you have an example and which tokenizer version?

Mei Chen: sample below (shortened). note the fullwidth comma vs ascii comma mix. token counts changed and detok produced different spacing.
```
src: 今日は、hello。よろしくお願いします。
ref: Today, hello. Nice to meet you.
orca-lite-q4: Today , hello . よろしくお願いします 。
baseline: Today, hello. よろしくお願いします。
```
(measured with our ja-zh devset, 1k sentences)

Taka Yamamoto: :eyes: that looks like a normalization/width-mapping issue. did the tokenizer pipeline switch normalization forms recently (NFKC/NFKD) or enable width folding?

Mei Chen: tokenizer reported: "tokenizers v0.12.1" on baseline, staging run using container image built from main that pulled tokenizers 0.14.0 and our new preproc. quick diff shows a new call to `unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', s)` in preprocess.py introduced in commit 9b7fafe.

models-ci-bot: [regression-alert] eval/orca-lite-v2/q4 staging-run-2026-05-04 failed quality gate: BLEU -3.2 (threshold -1.0). run_id: run-20260504-1732.

Arjun Patel: could we reproduce by toggling normalize? try running eval with `--preserve_fullwidth=true` or skip the NFKC step. i can spin a quick job.

Mei Chen: tried `--preserve_fullwidth=true` locally. small script: `python evals/run.py --model orca-lite-v2-q4 --tokenizer-opts preserve_fullwidth=true`
result: BLEU delta = -0.1 (within noise). Token alignment identical to baseline for these samples.

Taka Yamamoto: ok that pins it to the normalization codepath. For CJK mixing you must be careful — NFKC will fold zenkaku punctuation into ascii which shifts token boundaries for models trained with explicit fullwidth tokens. We intentionally kept fullwidth punctuation during baseline training. The new preprocess change was intended to reduce token vocab explosion but regresses mixed-script detok.

Jasmine Rivera: action items: 1) roll back normalize change in staging (temporary). 2) add a unit test in tokenizers that asserts fullwidth punctuation preservation for ja/zh/ko samples. 3) add a gating eval that includes mixed-width punctuation cases. I'll file a ticket.

Arjun Patel: running a full 1k eval with preserve_fullwidth and with tokenizers pinned to v0.12.1 now, will post numbers in ~45m.

Mei Chen: quick numbers from Arjun's job: `preserve_fullwidth=true` => BLEU delta -0.08, same token counts. pin tokenizers v0.12.1 => BLEU delta -0.05. Both consistent with fix.

Taka Yamamoto: long term fix options: (a) add opt-in width-folding when model vocab expects it, determined at model on-boarding; (b) keep NFKC but map fullwidth punctuation back to separate special tokens before tokenization; (c) keep pipeline but add eval gating. I prefer (a) + (c).

Jasmine Rivera: ticket filed: RL-3421 — "preserve fullwidth punctuation gating + revert accidental NFKC in default preproc". assigning to @Taka and @Arjun for follow-up. adding unit test checklist.

models-ci-bot: scheduled: re-run gating jobs for run-20260504-1732 with tokenizers pinned. ETA 2026-05-04T18:00Z.

Mei Chen: thanks everyone. next steps: (1) revert the normalization line in staging images, (2) push short-term config flag for preserve_fullwidth default true for ja/zh/ko models, (3) add the mixed-width punctuation eval to our small gating suite. i'll add the sample set to repo under evals/fixtures/mixed_width_punct. :+1:

Arjun Patel: ack, will follow up with PRs for the image revert and eval job changes.

Taka Yamamoto: i'll draft the onboarding note so new models make the width behavior explicit in their manifest.

Mei Chen: closing loop here — nice catch from the staging alert. this was subtle, would have been easy to miss without the mixed-punct set.
